src/business/services/OrderService.ts cancelOrder: calls order.cancel() and then saves through this.orders.save(toOrderRecord(order)), which is gateway use only with no storage details

parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderService is a Service Layer in the business (domain) layer. It runs use cases (placeOrder, cancelOrder, getOrder) and hands the business rules to domain objects: Product.reserve, Order.cancel, PricingPolicy.discountFor and Money/OrderLine arithmetic. Failures are raised as domain BusinessErrors. It reaches persistence only through injected gateway calls, with no SQL, storage, connection or transaction-engine code. It has no transport or framework logic. Mapping between records and domain objects is done by RecordMapping, not inline. One small smell: cancelOrder adds stock back directly with record.stock + line.quantity instead of calling a domain method. That is still business logic in the business layer, so it is not a responsibility from a different layer kind. No responsibility belongs to the infrastructure or presentation kinds.
